name: Gradient Computation & Smoothing
aliases: Gradient Computation via Compute Shader with Box Filter Smoothing
definition: GPU-accelerated calculation of volume gradients for lighting/shading, followed by spatial smoothing to reduce noise in the gradient field.
summary: Gradient Computation and Smoothing is a two-pass GPU pipeline that calculates volume gradients for lighting and applies a box filter to reduce noise in the gradient field.
